plugins.name: ai-jury
plugins.description: Cross-vendor multi-agent review jury skill for Claude Code. Drives native vendor CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity) to review the same diff/PR, debate, and synthesize one verdict. Requires the `jury` CLI on PATH.

plugins.name: jury-progress
plugins.description: Optional Claude Code mod: the live ai-jury runs above the prompt (phase, each seat's state) and a /jury-progress pane, read from the metadata-only events jury writes to $JURY_EVENTS_DIR. Read-only; needs Claude Code 2.1.287+.
